note: Both sets share significant errors confusing the 'Cameras' and 'Spectrometers' sections of Table 5.5-3, specifically attributing IR Spectrometer specifications (FOV, array width, detector) to the 'IR Guide camera'. However, Set B is better because it correctly extracts the Visible Camera FOV (11.9") and avoids Set A's incorrect claim that the Visible Camera array width is 4,096 pixels (a spectrometer value).
